title: Validation Requirements Schedule, SSL/TLS Certificates
content:
Before a certificate of SSL/TLS Certificates is issued, the partner certificate authority must validate the order at the level the product carries. This schedule sets out, product by product, the validation level, the domain control validation methods accepted, the mailbox names accepted for approver email, the organisation requirements, the targeted time to issuance and the number of calendar days an order may stay pending validation.

## Validation level and domain control methods

| Certificate product | Validation level | Domain control methods accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | DV | DNS CNAME record, HTTP file, approver email |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | DV | DNS CNAME record, HTTP file, approver email |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | DV | DNS CNAME record, approver email |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | OV | DNS CNAME record, HTTP file, approver email |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | OV | DNS CNAME record, approver email |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | EV | DNS CNAME record, HTTP file, approver email |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | EV | DNS CNAME record, HTTP file, approver email |

**Approver email mailboxes (every product):** admin, administrator, hostmaster, postmaster and webmaster at the domain.

**Automatic DNS validation (every product):** Yes. DNS validation is completed automatically when the domain is registered with Harborline, active and on Harborline DNS.

## Organisation requirements and timing

| Certificate product | Registered legal entity required | Verified telephone callback to the organisation | Organisation evidence accepted | Business days targeted from order to issuance once documents are complete | Calendar days after the order date after which an order still pending validation is cancelled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | No | No | none | 0 | 30 |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | No | No | none | 0 | 30 |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | No | No | none | 0 | 30 |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | Yes | Yes | government registry, Dun & Bradstreet, legal opinion letter | 3 | 30 |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | Yes | Yes | government registry, Dun & Bradstreet, legal opinion letter | 3 | 30 |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | Yes | Yes | government registry, legal opinion letter | 5 | 30 |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | Yes | Yes | government registry, legal opinion letter | 5 | 30 |

Business days are Monday to Friday excluding US federal holidays. A target of 0 business days means the same day.

## Points of reading

- **Wildcard products and HTTP file.** The Harborline DV Wildcard and the Harborline OV Wildcard list only the DNS CNAME record and approver email among their methods.
- **Evidence for EV.** Dun & Bradstreet appears among the organisation evidence accepted for the two OV products and not among that accepted for the two EV products.
- **Targets.** The issuance targets are business-day targets counted once the documents are complete; for the three DV products the target is the same day.
